summary: Command Palette (RT-38a) tech approach complete. Key decisions: module-level Map for action registry (not Zustand — not reactive state), substring matching (not fuzzy lib — 20 commands + 500 items is trivial), single global keydown handler in AppShell, item search from React Query cache (no server endpoint). 7 new files, 3 extended, zero Restructure classifications — no regression risk. Palette mounted at AppShell level, z-index 60. No backend changes, no new dependencies. Robert now writing design spec (RT-38b).
